# Installed local face selection

The original fixture is generated by `tools/local_font_face_fixture.py`. It
references installed Franklin Gothic Demi, Franklin Gothic Book and Arial; no
font file is bundled or downloaded. The reference application exported the reference on
2026-09-18 without saving the source. Hashes and PDF face names are recorded.

On this Windows host, at 16 px the string `LIST OF FIGURES` measured 128.90625 px
under the unregistered CSS family name Franklin Gothic Demi, exactly the Noto
fallback width. Loading the installed local face under an explicit FontFace alias
produced 120.0625 px. Franklin Gothic Book and Arial were already selectable as
CSS families and needed no registration. The implementation now binds only an
otherwise unselectable local face to its document name.

The browser regression independently loads an installed full/PostScript face as
a reference and verifies exact canvas advance equality after registration. It
uses host-specific candidates and skips only if none exhibits the distinction.
Mandatory mocked unit cases cover registration, concurrent requests, native-family
preservation and missing fonts. Generic document font tests cover editing/export;
this fixture also passed local open, edit, export, exact undo and reopen checks.

This is a browser font-selection correction under ECMA-376 Part 1 §17.3.2.26
(`rFonts`), not an observed reference/spec divergence. The fixture's overall paragraph
spacing and synthesized bold do not yet reproduce the reference application exactly. No claim of full
font-metric or pixel equivalence is made.
